name: Halcyon Cove
desc: Fishing hamlet. Start. Raided in prologue; rebuilt over the game.

name: Argyros
desc: Silver-mining town of tunnels, bellows and smoke. Miners' guild; Hephaestus smiths.

name: Pythona
desc: Oracle town on a gorge lip. Temple of the Pythia, ruined theatre, laurel groves.

name: Mycenor
desc: Cliff fortress, Lion Gate, cursed House of the Atreids; warrior culture.

name: Ephyra
desc: River-port merchant town. Market, shipwrights, shady alleys, Hermes' shrine.

name: Castra Lupa
desc: Legion fortress on the Tiberis. Barracks, parade ground, wolf statue.

name: Aventina
desc: Capital on seven hills. Forum, Senate Palace, baths, arena.

name: Cumae Vetus
desc: Town of the Sibyl on the shore of Lake Avernus. Cave oracle, fog, tombs.

name: Lavinium
desc: Farm town of Trojan descendants. Granaries, festival ground, Aeneas shrine.

name: Ostia Nova
desc: Harbor town at the Tiberis mouth. Docks, salt, lighthouse, sailors' guild.

name: Lemnos Village
desc: Island village of smiths under a volcano. Forge of Hephaestus mini-dungeon. Only inhabited island.
